messages:
liz_cs: Quick sync — wave 0 adopters: 8 companies accepted, 3 still pending legal. Need a plan for onboarding slots + feedback collection.

omar_csm: thanks. which companies pending?

liz_cs: Pending: Northbeam (legal), Kestrel Labs (SLA questions), Mistral Health (PO delay). I'll paste list.

liz_cs: ```csv
company,owner,requested_start
northbeam,omar,2026-04-07
kestrel,kestrel_ops,2026-04-12
mistral,liam,2026-04-20
```

hana_onboard: I can run two 1h onboarding slots w/enablement next Tue/Thu 10am PT. Prefer we triage Northbeam legal before seat provisioning :+1:

ben_eng: FYI: model quota for the trial group is set low. If they want parallel testing we'll need to bump to dedicated burst. ETA to increase is ~48h.

liz_cs: noted. Omar can you confirm legal point w/ Northbeam? If no greenlight by Tue, move them to hold and offer extra enablement session.

omar_csm: pinged legal, they want contract amendment for data retention. I'll loop legal+customer today. @liz_cs can you draft the amendment bullet points? I'll pair w/ legal.

liz_cs: drafting now — will send PR to docs for review by EOD. Also propose we ship a short feedback survey post-onboard (3 q). Link draft: https://forms.gle/example-survey . Thoughts?

ben_eng: keep it short. prefer single numeric NPS + 2 open fields. Also include checkbox for "need follow-up session" so we can triage.

hana_onboard: agreed. I'll add survey to onboarding workflow and set automated Slack reminder 48h after session.

coach-bot: calendar event created: "Wave 0 Onboard - Tue 10am PT" with attendees: hana_onboard,liz_cs,omar_csm (event: 2026-04-07T17:00:00Z)

liz_cs: action items: (1) liz draft amendment (2) omar legal convo (3) hana schedule sessions (4) ben prod quota bump request. I'll update enrollment tracker after each. :clipboard:

omar_csm: thanks team — aiming to avoid renewal risk by making first 30 days smooth. will report back by EOD.
